messages.author: 33899ed1aae53fa6
messages.subject: Send file: no stopping with error warning!
parts:
Hi Jakson! 

Is possible send file without it stops with error messages? If not, and if it would be possible, would be interesting to implement this command. Why? Sometimes we have huge scripts in which we need to perform only part of it. Part of this depends on other objects previously created. I came across this problem now. I just need to adjust some graphics for publication that are in an big code. Obviously this code is derived from analyzes in which there are attempts to adjustments for a particular purpose. When this adjustment does not occur, the messages appear as usual in R. Therefore, I have to send line by line all the code to be able to reach my goal. The command "send file" would be solution the problem if it would stop in the middle of the error messages.

Thanks!

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Send file: no stopping with error warning!
parts:
Sorry, but I don't know how to do what you want with R scripts: the Vim-R-plugin sends to R the command base::source() to evaluate the whole R script, and source() doesn't have any argument to ignore errors.

When the plugin was in its early stages of development, multiple lines of code were sent directly to R Console instead of being sourced, but sometimes the code was either incompletely or incorrectly pasted in the R console.
